about.bio: I'm a Full-Stack & DevOps Engineer specializing in Python (FastAPI), React, TypeScript, and cloud infrastructure. At Schultech GmbH, I manage server architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and system observability with Grafana, while building media technology integrations. I also bring deep expertise in the Atlassian ecosystem, having built custom Ansible automation for enterprise Jira and Confluence syncing. As an extroverted engineer who loves working directly with clients, I thrive at the intersection of complex system design, infrastructure, and clear communication.
about.visaText: I hold a valid German work visa and am fully authorized to work in Germany and the EU. No visa sponsorship, relocation paperwork, or additional immigration support is required from the employer.

portfolio.cloudManagerDescription: Cloud platform for Schultech to remotely monitor, configure, and operate media technology in schools. It integrates with on-site hardware, surfaces analytics on device health and state, and uses a cloud proxy between the platform and classroom devices. A visual graphic editor lets teams design and apply AV configurations. Currently in active development.
portfolio.homelabTitle: HomeLab: Family Cloud & Secure Backup Infrastructure
portfolio.homelabDescription: Engineered a private family cloud setup hosting Immich for automated iPhone media backups. Configured a secure VPN tunnel (WireGuard/Tailscale) to eliminate exposed public ports while maintaining seamless remote access. Deployed and managed containerized services using Docker and Portainer, focusing on network security, storage efficiency, and zero-trust principles.
portfolio.invoicingDescription: Developed the full-stack architecture for a fintech platform used to manage freelancers, invoice tracking, and affiliate payouts. Implemented strict access control logic, secure API routes, and reliable data validation to handle financial records safely across different user roles.
portfolio.affiliateTitle: B2B Affiliate & Developer Integration Platform (Pet Project / MVP)
portfolio.affiliateDescription: Engineered a functional MVP for a B2B affiliate platform to practice building custom API Developer Portals. Designed and implemented secure API key generation, rate-limiting, and authentication mechanisms to enable programmatic integrations with third-party partners. Built REST endpoints to aggregate travel booking metadata and commission logic in real time, focusing on scalable backend architecture and secure data flows.

experience.schultech1: DevOps & Infrastructure: Built and maintained server infrastructure from scratch; designed and automated CI/CD pipelines for zero-downtime deployments.
experience.schultech2: Observability: Configured system-wide monitoring and alerting dashboards using Grafana to track server health, latency, and uptime.
experience.schultech3: Cloud Manager & Security: Built an internal Cloud Manager platform, implementing enterprise SSO (OAuth2), two-factor authentication (2FA), and strict RBAC access policies.
experience.schultech4: Backend & API Design: Engineered scalable microservices and REST APIs using Python (FastAPI) for media technology integration in educational institutions.
experience.schultech5: Frontend & UX: Developed responsive web interfaces using React & TypeScript, turning complex stakeholder requirements into intuitive tools.
experience.polygran1: Infra Automation: Engineered an Ansible-based automation app to sync enterprise Atlassian instances across environments, cutting sync time from 40 to 5 minutes (87% reduction) and eliminating a single point of failure by enabling any authorized engineer to run updates safely.
experience.polygran2: Software Development: Built the frontend for a banking application focused on freelancer management and invoice control (React/FastAPI).
experience.polygran3: Enterprise Consulting: Managed complex Atlassian workflows and custom integrations while working directly with business stakeholders.
experience.ame1: Completed 180+ hours of agile management training, leading stakeholder analysis and delivery process optimizations.
experience.wemake1: Developed modern web applications using React and TypeScript; designed a reusable UI component library that accelerated development speed by 30%.
